shard.name: Project Zomboid
shard.description: Hardcore isometric zombie survival multiplayer dedicated server by The Indie Stone.
shard.author: The Indie Stone & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Project Zomboid Dedicated Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing Project Zomboid (App ID 380870)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 380870 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x start-server.sh ProjectZomboid64
echo "Project Zomboid installation completed!"
